Every game-side playbook is still under 30 bets (arb 18 at +3.8% CLV on 16, longshot 9 at -$45 yet +5.4% CLV, value_dog 12 paused at -1.1%, matchup_over 11 at +$19.20 but -0.9% CLV), so they stay put; props show no CLV gradient by edge (10%+ -3.8%, under 3% -4.1%) and the anchor governs them, so prop_min_edge and prop_model_weight stay put and kelly_mult is at its 0.05 floor.
